deficits.suggestion: Install dropped kerbs at the marked pedestrian crossing to improve accessibility for wheelchair users and those with mobility aids.
Add a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the marked crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing a wide road.
Install additional street lighting along the road to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.

ratings.reason: The frames do not show the pedestrian crossing clearly enough to confirm the absence of dropped kerbs.
The road width and the specific location for a refuge island are not clearly visible in the provided frames.
The frames are taken during the day, making it impossible to assess the adequacy of street lighting.
